subject: Partner Lunch & Learn micro-series — kickoff and calendar sync

Cc: Ahmed Nassar <ahmed@scalecloud.co>
Date: Fri, 3 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lunch & Learn micro-series idea — quick pilot?

Hi Dylan,

Hope youre well — VectorScale runs a series of small in-market Lunch & Learn sessions for customers and prospects (30–40 people) where we bring a short tech talk + live demo and a host-meet Q&A. Were looking to pilot a co-hosted version with just one partner per region and thought Redwood would be a great fit given your inference story.

High-level ask: co-host one 60-minute session (30 min talk + 20 min demo + 10 min Q&A), VectorScale handles local venue, invites and catering, Redwood provides speaker(s), a short demo + 1-sheeter, and a modest MDF contribution. Wed like to run the first pilot in the SF Bay Area week of Nov 16 or Nov 30 — flexibility on the date.

Attached is a one-page outline with draft audience profile and expected CPL expectations. If this sounds interesting, can you confirm:
- Who on your side would own the demo speaker and collateral?
- Approx MDF range youd be comfortable committing for a pilot (wed aim to keep total event cost ~ $5k–8k).
- Any blackout dates in Nov/Dec for Redwood?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call to align.

Best,
Susan King
Partnerships Lead, VectorScale
Attachments: VS_LunchLearn_Scope_v1.pdf
From: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 3 Oct 2026 10:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lunch & Learn micro-series idea — quick pilot?

Hi Susan — great idea and thanks for the outline. Laura (Field Events) and Sergio (Partnerships/Sales) looped in to scope. Quick answers up front:
- Demo speaker: I can lead the demo content, will coordinate with Product to keep it focused (15–20 mins hands-on inference demo + 10-min architecture Q&A).
- MDF: we can commit $2k–3k for a pilot in-region, plus headcount / drinks. If VectorScale covers venue/catering, that should get you into the target budget.
- Blackouts: were tight the week of Nov 9 (company offsite) but Nov 16 and Nov 30 both look possible today.

Next steps:
1) Laura — can you confirm local logistics support and whether Redwood can provide printed 1-sheeters?
2) Sergio — well need a short mutual action plan and a simple cost split to get procurement started.
3) Susan/Ahmed — if you confirm preferred date (Nov 17–19 window or Nov 30/Dec 1), Ill draft a 1-page MOU and send a calendar placeholder.

Thanks,
Dylan
Director, Partner Growth | Redwood Inference

Folks — forwarding the outline from VectorScale. Quick internal notes and ask for Marissa/Laura:
- Proposed MDF: Dylan suggested $2k–3k. Per prior co-marketing guidance, we should aim to cover up to 50% of venue/catering for a first pilot for strategic partners. Can you confirm whether $3k max is approvable from the co-marketing pool?
- Collateral: Redwood to provide 1-sheeter + 2x printed handouts (we may also provide a small sticker/lanyard promo).
- Speaker travel: Dylan will speak locally (no travel request).
- Registration goals: VectorScale set target 30–40 qualified leads; we should agree on joint registration form and lead handling (GDPR opt-in if any EMEA attendees show).

Marissa — can you draft a 1-pager budget split and a simple MAP (mutual action plan) that we can send to Susan by Wednesday? Include an operations checklist: AV, seating plan, Wi-Fi test, signage, lead capture (QR + CSV export).

Thanks,
Sergio
